### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #40943

Description: We copy most of the `like` function codes to implement the ilike function.

### What is changed and how it works?

- Move some functions to `builtin_func_param.go`
- Modify the parser to support `ilike`
- Change the name of regexpParam to funcParam
- support `ilike` function
